title: 第3章 寿元暴涨痴傻伪装避锋芒第4章 柴房密谈苟道真谛初悟
slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
泥水顺着发白的发梢不断滴落，在沾满血污的脸颊拉出一道道黑痕。
良久，陈默睫毛微颤，骤然睁眼。
右眼底那抹独有的琥珀色精光一闪而逝，快得如同幻觉，只剩一片空洞浑浊的麻木。
他没有起身，更没有急着探查伤势。整个人贴死在湿冷淤泥地里，双耳紧紧贴着地面，极致凝神，扫遍整座谷底的动静。
岩壁滴水，啪嗒、啪嗒。
几声细碎鱼跃，转瞬死寂。
断龙崖底，空无一人。
他太清楚自己的身体变化。
不止是伤势痊愈，而是脱胎换骨。断裂的筋骨尽数接合，肺腑撕裂的剧痛彻底消散，头脑清明透彻，经脉里涌动着一股前所未有的充盈暖流。
陈默五指猛地扣进淤泥，指节发力。
扎实、稳健、力量充沛。
远超他坠崖之前的孱弱状态。
闭目内视，神魂扫过命数根基。
寿元四十年。
硬生生翻倍。
崖顶所有冷眼与算计，此刻依旧清晰刻在神魂深处。玄霄子的薄情宣判、李慕白暗中阴狠的绊脚、满场同门的漠然旁观、柳如烟全程的沉默退让……一幕一幕，分毫未忘，字字刻骨。
以死换余生，这笔账，血血相抵，半点不亏。
念头冷硬落地，陈默压下所有心绪。
他不能醒。
至少，不能清醒着回玄霄宗。

一个本该摔死在万丈深渊的废徒，突然完好无损归来，只会被冠上邪祟附体、魔修夺舍的罪名。届时宗门强者齐出，他刚捡回来的性命，转瞬就会葬送。
想要活下去、藏住底牌、伺机翻盘，唯有一计——装疯。
装得彻底，装得真实，装到所有人都笃定，他是坠崖摔碎了脑子，彻底成了废人。
陈默缓缓抬身，动作僵硬滞涩，关节转动带着木偶般的生硬是刻意伪装。
他抬手狠狠搓过脸颊，硬生生抠下脸上干结的血痂，混着冰冷泥水胡乱抹匀，让整张脸污秽狼藉，看不出半点原本神色。
做完这一切，他眼底彻底放空，瞳孔涣散，嘴角不受控制般耷拉下来，一缕口水顺着唇角滑落，满脸痴傻疯癫之态。
一步踉跄，他直直踩进深水滩。
冰冷泥水没过脚踝，溅起的水花惊得水底小鱼四散逃窜。他浑然不觉，脚步歪斜扭曲，左脚拖沓拖地，右脚刻意高抬，落地猛地一滑，整个人结结实实扑撞在岸边顽石上。
额头重重磕在石棱，瞬间撞出一片红紫淤青。
钝痛传来，他不躲不闪，反倒仰头，发出两声沙哑诡异的憨笑。
“师尊……拿剑砍我头……要杀我……”
嗓音粗粝破碎，带着极致的惶恐疯癫。
他撑着地面爬起，踉踉跄跄往山上走，一路撞树绊石，跌跌爬爬，毫无章法。途经溪流，他猛地俯身，整张脸狠狠按进冷水里，强行呛入数口冰水，剧烈咳嗽不止。
content_en:
Mud water continued to drip down the tips of the white hair, leaving black marks on the blood-stained cheeks.
After a long time, Chen Mo's eyelashes trembled slightly and he suddenly opened his eyes.
The unique amber light in his right eye flashed away, as fast as an illusion, leaving only a hollow and turbid numbness.
He did not get up, nor did he rush to explore the injury. His whole body was stuck to the cold, wet mud, his ears pressed tightly to the ground, and he was extremely focused, scanning the entire valley for movement.
Water drips from the rock wall, patter, patter.
A few tiny sounds of fish leaping, followed by an instant of dead silence.
There was no one at the bottom of Broken Dragon Cliff.
He is very aware of the changes in his body.
Not only is the injury healed, but he is transformed. All the broken muscles and bones were rejoined, the severe pain of tearing in the lungs was completely dissipated, the mind was clear and clear, and an unprecedented warm current surged through the meridians.
Chen Mo dug his fingers into the mud and exerted force on his knuckles.
Solid, steady and powerful.
Far beyond the weak state before he fell off the cliff.
Close your eyes and look inside, your soul sweeps over the foundation of destiny.
Life span is forty years.
Hardly doubled.
All the cold looks and calculations on the top of the cliff are still clearly engraved deep in the soul at this moment. Xuan Xiaozi's ruthless pronouncement, Li Mubai's secret and sinister stumbling, the indifferent onlookers of his classmates, Liu Ruyan's silent retreat throughout the whole process... each scene is unforgettable, every word is engraved in my heart.
Death in exchange for the rest of life, this account is evenly balanced with blood, and there is no loss at all.
The thought fell to the ground coldly, and Chen Mo suppressed all his thoughts.
He can't wake up.
At least, he couldn't return to Xuanxiao Sect sober.
A useless person who should have fallen to death in the abyss suddenly returns intact, and will only be accused of being possessed by evil spirits and possessing the body of a demonic cultivator. When all the strong men from the sect come out, the life he just saved will be ruined in an instant.
If you want to survive, hide your cards, and wait for an opportunity to make a comeback, there is only one way - pretend to be crazy.
Pretend to be thorough, pretend to be true, until everyone is convinced that he fell off a cliff and shattered his brain, becoming a complete invalid.
Chen Mo slowly raised his body, his movements were stiff and sluggish, and the movements of his joints were as stiff as a puppet's, which was a deliberate disguise.
He raised his hands and rubbed his cheeks hard, plucked off the dried blood scabs on his face, and mixed it with cold muddy water and spread it evenly, leaving his whole face dirty and messy, and no trace of his original expression could be seen.
After doing all this, his eyes were completely empty, his pupils were dilated, the corners of his mouth drooped uncontrollably, a wisp of saliva slipped down the corners of his lips, and his face was full of stupidity and madness.
With a staggering step, he stepped straight into the deep water.
The cold muddy water was up to my ankles, and the splashing water scared the small fish under the water and fled in all directions. He was completely unaware that his steps were crooked and twisted, his left foot dragged on the ground, and his right foot was deliberately raised high. When he landed, he suddenly slipped and his whole body hit the hard rocks on the shore.
His forehead hit the stone edge hard, causing a red and purple bruise in an instant.
Dull pain came, and he did not dodge. Instead, he raised his head and let out two hoarse and weird laughs.
"Master...take a sword and chop off my head...want to kill me..."
The voice was rough and broken, with the ultimate fear and madness.
He climbed up on the ground and staggered up the mountain, bumping into trees and stumbling blocks along the way, stumbling and climbing without any plan. Passing by a stream, he leaned over suddenly and pressed his entire face into the cold water. He forcefully choked in several mouthfuls of ice water and coughed violently.
